title: Strategy list hides drafts by default with a state filter and server paging

ac1_default_excludes_drafts.detail: Opening /management/strategies with no query requests GET /bff/strategies?exclude_state=draft&page_size=20 and renders no draft rows.

ac2_state_control_counts_and_query_param.detail: State filter control offers default (hide drafts), approved, review, retired, draft, and all (plus active CommandCenter DTO state query links such as paper_running) with counts derived from meta.state_counts, sends the selected filter to the BFF, and persists state=<value> in the URL query parameter.

ac3_hidden_drafts_banner_and_null_counts.detail: Default view displays a banner stating how many draft strategies are hidden with a one-click Show drafts button that switches to state=draft; when meta.state_counts is null, the control and banner still work and never invent a count.

ac4_server_paging_and_total.detail: StrategiesList pages through GET /bff/strategies using page_size=20 and page_token (Next, Previous, First, Last), displays page_info.total (including 4898 in the all view), reaches row 4898 via page_token=4880, and never fetches multiple pages at once.

ac5_separate_loading_error_empty_states.detail: Loading, degraded read failure, and truly empty filter states remain distinct on ObjectListPage, and other lists sharing ObjectListPage are unchanged.

ac6_draft_direct_url_and_create_navigati.detail: Direct URL /management/strategies/<draft-id> remains reachable via GET /bff/strategies/<id>. Registered strategy: 'POST /bff/strategies' in DURABLE_CREATE_OWNERS, implemented createStrategy in src/lib/bff-v1/strategies.ts against the existing backend StrategiesService.create_strategy contract using typed canonical bffFetch<{ data: Strategy; meta?: ManagementListMeta }> (normalizing allowed request fields once, forcing only request state: 'draft', sending Idempotency-Key header, omitting 'you' placeholder owner, validating actual nonempty canonical data.id and actual data.state === 'draft' without alias/raw-envelope/defaulted-state fallbacks or action blacklists, and returning the owner DTO unchanged while preserving listStrategies/getStrategy unchanged), wired createEntityFromInput('strategy', ...) without duplicated normalization, buildEntity, or writeOverlay, and verified end-to-end drawer creation on /management/strategies navigating to /management/strategies/<server-id> and surviving direct URL reload.

ac7_no_weakened_or_deleted_tests.detail: Zero pre-existing tests on origin/dev were weakened, modified, or deleted; 19 new unit/integration tests were added across strategies.test.ts, createEntity.test.ts, contract-drift.test.ts, lists.test.ts, Lists.test.tsx, and ObjectListPage.test.tsx (9 test files, 92 tests passing). In newly added strategies.test.ts and createEntity.test.ts (from audit ref ff95d7314fb02686ef5cad3dbf664ffa1ee80849, anchored on 6ff8e5d5c19820a33c73238269c431e59f6755d2), response fixtures were aligned to the actual current StrategiesService.create_strategy owner DTO and newly written client-side action-blacklist filtering / metric-nulling fallback / duplicated-normalization assertions were replaced with strict unchanged owner-DTO return assertions plus missing-state ({ data: { id: 's' } }) and malformed-canonical-data regressions per Codex review.
